values.goal: Coordinate Sprint 3 cloud convergence closeout as one bounded evidence and review workflow without absorbing child implementation.
values.required_outcome: One reviewable Sprint 3 result records roster version 4, child dispositions, reviewed merge heads, green checks, merge commits, ancestry, residual risks, and truthful typed lifecycle status.
declared_scope: Sprint-level evidence, review, validation, publication, and closeout truth
authority_boundary: Typed C-SDLC v2 lifecycle state remains operational authority
Live GitHub issue and PR state is authoritative for remote dispositions
Child issue implementation, paid cloud proof, and resource operations remain outside the umbrella boundary
operator_constraints: Do not implement child work inside the umbrella
Do not serialize children without a declared dependency
Do not treat child typed finish or cleanup as a dependency for another child
Keep AWS, paid launches, and big-runner usage off unless separately authorized
Preserve current main and other-session worktree ownership
